    {"description": "Design", "qty": 3, "unit_cents": 12000},
    {"description": "Hosting", "qty": 12, "unit_cents": 1500},
]

def test_invoice_total_includes_tax(tmp_path):
    app = create_app(db_path=tmp_path / "test.db")

    invoice_id = seed_invoice(app, lines=LINES, tax_rate=TAX_RATE)

    expected_total = round(subtotal * (1 + TAX_RATE))

    response = client.get(f"/api/invoices/{invoice_id}/total")

    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert response.json()["total_cents"] == expected_total


def test_unknown_invoice_404s(tmp_path):
    client = TestClient(create_app(db_path=tmp_path / "test.db"))
    assert client.get("/api/invoices/inv_missing/total").status_code == 404

from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from unittest.mock import patch

from notify.throttle import Throttle

T0 = datetime(2024, 5, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc)


class ThrottleTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_allows_first_call_and_blocks_second_in_window(self):
        with patch("notify.throttle.clock.now", return_value=T0):
            throttle = Throttle(window=timedelta(seconds=1))
            self.assertTrue(throttle.allow("user_1"))
            self.assertFalse(throttle.allow("user_1"))

    def test_allows_again_after_window(self):
        throttle = Throttle(window=timedelta(seconds=1))
        with patch("notify.throttle.clock.now", return_value=T0):
            throttle.allow("user_1")
        with patch("notify.throttle.clock.now", return_value=T0 + timedelta(seconds=2)):
            self.assertTrue(throttle.allow("user_1"))

    def test_tracks_keys_independently(self):
        with patch("notify.throttle.clock.now", return_value=T0):
            throttle = Throttle(window=timedelta(seconds=1))
            throttle.allow("user_1")
